entry.name: umenu
entry.description: Displays text as a pop-up menu. Selections can be made manually, or set incoming numbers. Outputs both selection number and selection text.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Sets the text alignment mode. Alignment modes are:0 left (the default)1 center (1)2 right alignment (2)

attributes.name: allowdrag
attributes.description: Toggles the ability of using drag & drop from a folder to populate theobject (default = 1).

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: applycolors
attributes.description: Whenis on, andis set to "Normal", the background of the drop-down menu will use the.

attributes.name: arrow
attributes.description: Toggles the drawing of the down arrow on theobject (default = 1).

attributes.name: autopopulate
attributes.description: Toggles the automatic population of anobject with folder contents (default = 0). The automatic population will occur when it receives a valid folder path as the argument to a prefix message, or at patcher load, if a valid prefix is stored with the object. See the prefix, populate, and types message descriptions for more information.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bgfillcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color of theobject in RGBA format.

attributes.name: blanksym
attributes.digest: Symbol To Output For Empty Text

attributes.name: collection
attributes.description: Toggles the automatic population of anobject with the contents of a Collections folder (default = 1). The automatic population will occur when theattribute is enabled.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Sets the toggle ON color in RGBA format. When theis set to "Toggle", theattribute sets the active font color.

attributes.name: depth
attributes.description: Sets the folder recursion depth used by theobject when populating from a valid file path.

attributes.name: elementcolor
attributes.description: Sets the toggle OFF color in RGBA format. When theis set to "Toggle", theattribute sets the inactive font color.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Theattribute, which is only accessible using theobject's Inspector, lets you enter the items which you want to appear on the menu by typing into a dialog box. Menu items are separated by by commas (e.g., red, orange, yellow, green).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: labelclick
attributes.description: Toggles Label Click mode on or off. In this mode, when the object is in Label mode, you can click in the object's rectangle and the current value of the menu is sent out the left outlet. In addition, the text of the current item is shown underlined.

attributes.name: menumode
attributes.description: Sets the appearance and behavior of theobject. The modes are:0: Normal mode - the normal pop-up menu (default).1: Scrolling mode - lets you scroll through the individual menu items by dragging the mouse up or down, displaying one item at a time.2: Label mode - shows the text of the selected menu item with no border around it, and does not respond to the mouse.3: Toggle mode - Clicking on the object in mode 3 causes it to alternate between an active and inactive state. When changing from inactive to active, the object sends the messagefrom its rightmost outlet, and changes to the color set using theattribute. When changing from active to inactive, the object sends the messagefrom its rightmost outlet, and changes to the color set using theattribute. Whether activating or deactivating, the object also sends its current message from the middle outlet and its current item number from the left outlet.Control-clicking allows you to change the current state of aobject in toggle mode.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.name: parameter_enable
attributes.description: Enables use of this object withandin Max.

attributes.name: parameter_mappable
attributes.description: When parameter_mappable is enabled, the object will be available for mapping to keyboard or MIDI input using the. (default = 1).

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: pattrmode
attributes.description: Sets the method used by theobject object to report its internal state to the pattr object. When the argument is 0 (default), theobject reports its internal state by number (e.g. item 3 of the list of items). When the argument is 1, theobject reports its internal state by symbol (e.g. item 'carrots' of the list of items).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Sets a menu-wide prefix, which can be concatenated or prepended to all menu item text before output. If the prefix is a valid folder path, the populate and types messages can be used to automatically fill theobject with a list of files in the folder. See the entries for those messages for more information. Sending a prefix message without any argument clears the currently stored prefix.

attributes.name: prefix_mode
attributes.description: Sets the output behavior of the prefix mode. The modes are:0: concatenate mode; the prefix is added to the front of the outgoing message without a space.1: prepend mode; the prefix is added to the front of the outgoing message list as a discrete symbol.2: ignore mode; the prefix is not used for output.

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: showdotfiles
attributes.digest: Show files beginning with a dot (.)
attributes.description: Toggles the display of files whose names begin with a dot (.). The default is off.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Sets theto be applied to the object. Styles can be set using the.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.description: Sets the text color of theobject in RGBA format. Theattribute is mapped to thestyle color.

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: truncate
attributes.description: Toggles the location of the truncation of text in theobject when the text is too long. The default is 1 (truncate the end of the text on the right-hand side). A value of 2 will cause the text to truncate in the middle in the same manner as the textbutton object.

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: Sets a file type filter for use by themessage. Up to 64 file types or file extensions (beginning with '.') may be entered as a list. By default, no file types are filtered. For a list of valid four-letter filetype codes, see theGuide.

attributes.name: underline
attributes.description: Toggles the underlining of text in theobject. The default is 0 (no underlining).

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: (drag)
messages.digest: Load the menu from a folder
messages.description: When a file folder is dragged from the Max File Browser to aobject, the folder's contents will be loaded into as menu choices.When a file folder is dragged from the Max File Browser to a blank space in an unlocked patcher window, aobject containing the folder's contents loaded will be created.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking with the mouse lets you select a menu item to be sent out, and causesto display that item.

messages.name: append
messages.description: The word, followed by any message, appends that message as the new last item in the menu.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends out the currently displayed menu item.

messages.name: checkitem
messages.digest: Set a menu item check mark
messages.description: The word, followed by an item number and 1 or 0, places (1) or removes (0) a check mark next to the item number.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Removes all items from the.

messages.name: clearchecks
messages.description: The wordremoves check marks for all items.

messages.name: count
messages.digest: Report the number of menu items
messages.description: Sends the number of items in theout the right outlet, preceded by the word.

messages.name: delete
messages.description: The word, followed by one or more numbers that correspond to items in the list, deletes the item or items from the.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.digest: Set the items forwith a dictionary
messages.description: The word, followed by a dictionary name, will set the menu items for. You can also attach the first outlet of aobject to the first inlet of. In order for this to work, the dictionary needs to include an "items" entry. For example, the following dictionary entry will populatewith the items "hank, carol, andreas, roland":"items" : [ "hank", "carol", "andreas", "roland" ]

messages.name: dump
messages.digest: Dump contents of umenu out rightmost outlet.
messages.description: Output is the word 'dump', the item's entry number, and the contents. ex: 'dump 1 one'.

messages.name: enableitem
messages.description: The word, followed by a number that specifies a menu item and a 1 or 0, enables or disables the specified item number. Disabled menu items cannot be selected, but their text and item number are sent from the rightmost outlet if the mouse is released while above them, prefixed by the symbolsand, respectively.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Converted to.

messages.name: gettoggle
messages.description: Reports the current value of theobject's toggle state (1 or 0, for on or off), from the right outlet, preceded by the word.

messages.name: insert
messages.description: The word, followed by a number and a message, inserts the message at the address specified by the number, incrementing all equal or greater addresses by 1 if necessary.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number specifies a menu item to be sent out, and causesto display that item. The items are numbered starting at 0. A menu item can also be chosen from a umenu with the mouse, as with any pop-up menu.

messages.name: mode
messages.description: Legacy message. Please use theattribute. The word, followed by a number in the range 1-4, sets the appearance and behavior of theobject. The normal pop-up menu style is 1 (the default). Scrolling mode (2) lets you scroll through the individual menu items by dragging the mouse up or down, displaying one item at a time. Label mode (3) shows the text of the selected menu item with no border around it, and does not respond to the mouse. Toggle mode (4) sets a button style. Clicking on the object in mode 3 causes it to alternate between an active and inactive state. When changing from inactive to active, the object sends the messagefrom its rightmost outlet. When changing from active to inactive, the object sends the messagefrom its rightmost outlet, and changes to the color set using theattribute. Whether activating or deactivating, the object also sends its current message from the middle outlet and its current item number from the left outlet.

messages.name: next
messages.description: Selects the next menu item and causes theobject to display that item. This message will ignore disabled or separator menu items.

messages.name: populate
messages.digest: Populate the menu with file names
messages.description: If theobject has a valid folder path as its, themessage will cause the menu to re-populate itslist, based on the current contents of the specified path (and filtered by thelist). After population is complete, the number of items added to theobject will be output from the right outlet, preceded by the word.

messages.name: prev
messages.description: Selects the previous menu item and causes theobject to display that item. This message will ignore disabled or separator menu items.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Select a menu item with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number or symbol, specifies a menu item to be displayed by, but does not send it out the outlet. If the set argument is a symbol,searches for a menu item which begins with the symbol.

messages.name: setcheck
messages.description: (Macintosh only) The word, followed by a number that specifies the decimal representation of a UTF-8 character (e.g. 8226 for a bullet or 62 for a greater than symbol), sets the character used to be the check mark. The wordwith no argument specifies the default square root checkbox.

messages.name: setitem
messages.description: The word, followed by an item number and any message, sets the specified menu item to that message.

messages.name: setrgb
messages.description: The word, followed by six numbers between 0 and 255 that specify RGB values, uses the first three numbers to set the foreground (text) color and the second three numbers to set the background (fill) color.
messages.argPattern: fore-red:int, fore-green:int, fore-blue:int, back-red:int, back-green:int, back-blue:int

messages.name: setsymbol
messages.digest: Select menu item with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a message, specifies a menu item to be displayed by name without triggering any output.

messages.name: settoggle
messages.description: The word, followed by a one or zero, sets theobject to the specified state if it is in toggle mode and performs output as if the object were clicked on (the symbol, followed by a zero or one, indicating the toggle state). Without an argument, the message simply toggles the object's state and triggers output.

messages.name: showchecked
messages.description: This message operates as follows. If the currently displayed item is checked, do nothing. Otherwise, starting at the first item in the menu, find one that is checked and set the menu to display that item. If there isn't one, do nothing.

messages.name: symbol
messages.digest: Select a menu item by name
messages.description: Identical to themessage with a symbol argument, except that the found item number is sent out (and the text of the item is sent out the right outlet, if the Evaluate Item Text feature is enabled).

messages.name: toggle
messages.description: The word, followed by a one or zero, sets theobject to the specified state if it is in toggle mode and performs output as if the object were clicked on (the symbol, followed by a zero or one, indicating the toggle state). Without an argument, the message simply toggles the object's state and triggers output.

outlets.digest: Menu Item Text Evaluated as a Message
